CALC_SIZER_LEVERAGE_TIP: The multiplier needed on your position size to risk exactly your target %, given how close your stop is. A tight stop needs high leverage to still hit your $ risk - it's a derived number, not a setting you choose separately.
CALC_SIZER_RR_TIP: Risk:Reward - how many dollars you stand to make for every dollar risked. 2R means a win pays double the loss. Below 1.5R, you need too high a win rate to be profitable long-term - the math doesn't work in your favor.

CALC_RR_EV_TIP: The average $ outcome per unit if you took this exact setup many times at the win rate you entered: (win% × TP distance) - (loss% × SL distance). Positive means the math favors taking the trade; negative means it doesn't, even if it 'feels' right.
CALC_RR_BREAKEVEN_TIP: The minimum win rate this exact R:R needs just to break even long-term. Win below this rate and you lose money overall; win above it and the setup is profitable.

DASH_EDGE_VWAP_TIP: Volume Weighted Average Price - the average price across the day, weighted by how much was traded at each level. Price above VWAP signals buy-side control; below signals sellers are in charge.
DASH_EDGE_OI_TIP: Open Interest is the total number of live futures contracts. Rising OI + rising price = new longs entering (real conviction). Falling OI + rising price = shorts covering (weaker signal).
DASH_EDGE_FUNDING_TIP: The fee longs pay shorts every 8 hours to keep perpetual futures positions open. Strongly positive means too many people are leveraged long - whales often dump price to liquidate them and pocket the fee.
DASH_EDGE_SETUP_TIP: Squeeze setup score: funding rate (0–40 pts) + long/short ratio positioning (0–40 pts) + volume spike bonus (0–20 pts). LONG_LIQ = longs overcrowded, ripe for a dump. SHORT_SQ = shorts overcrowded, ripe for a pump.
DASH_EDGE_CB_TIP: Coinbase price minus Binance price, as a %. Positive = US retail buyers are paying a premium (bullish signal). Negative = US retail selling at a discount (bearish signal).
DASH_EDGE_OI1H_TIP: How much the total value of open futures positions changed in the last hour. A sharp rise means new money is entering aggressively; a sharp drop means mass liquidations or traders closing positions.

LIVE_TRACKING_TIP_AVG_R: R = risk multiple. +1R means the trade won exactly what was risked (distance to stop-loss); +2R means it won double. Avg R across all trades tells you if wins are outsized enough to cover the losses.
LIVE_TRACKING_TIP_PROFIT_FACTOR: Total profit from winning trades divided by total loss from losing trades. Above 1.0 means the strategy is net profitable over this sample; below 1.0 means it's losing money even if the win rate looks decent.

FUNDING_REGIME_OVERVIEW_TIP: A snapshot of every coin's current funding regime: crowded-short setups (squeeze candidates), crowded-long setups (dump risk), and coins whose funding rate is extreme enough to arbitrage.
FUNDING_CONTRARIAN_SHORT_TIP: Coins where longs are overcrowded and overpaying to hold - contrarian read: the crowd is positioned to get flushed, so a short setup on weakness has an edge.
FUNDING_CONTRARIAN_LONG_TIP: Coins where shorts are overcrowded and overpaying to hold - contrarian read: the crowd is positioned to get squeezed, so a long setup on dips has an edge.
FUNDING_CARRY_ARB_TIP: Funding rate is extreme enough (over ~0.03%/8h) that a delta-neutral trade - long spot, short perp, or vice versa - can collect the funding payment with no directional price risk.
FUNDING_CARRY_ARB_FOOTNOTE: Carry Arb: annualized rate exceeds ~40% (|FR| greater than 0.03%/8h) - long spot + short perp captures the premium delta-neutral.

FUNDING_SIG_LONGS_HEAVY_ACTION: Reduce long exposure. Consider short entries.
FUNDING_SIG_LONGS_HEAVY_DESC: The market is significantly long-heavy. Every 8-hour settlement, longs are bleeding fees to hold their position. This builds pressure for a flush - the crowd is positioned for a pump, which makes a dump more likely.

FUNDING_SIG_LONGS_DOMINANT_ACTION: Trade cautiously. Exit if FR keeps climbing.

FUNDING_SIG_SLIGHT_LONG_DESC: Mildly more longs than shorts, but not enough to create a squeeze or dump setup. Price movement here is driven by spot buying and selling, not derivatives pressure.
FUNDING_SIG_BALANCED_ACTION: Wait for a clearer FR signal.
FUNDING_SIG_BALANCED_DESC: Longs and shorts are balanced. Nobody is paying a significant premium to hold their position. The derivatives market is not a driver right now - focus on chart structure and spot flow.
FUNDING_SIG_SHORTS_DOMINANT_ACTION: Slight bullish lean. Small long positions on dips.
FUNDING_SIG_SHORTS_DOMINANT_DESC: More shorts than longs in the market. Shorts are paying longs every 8h to hold their position. Mild squeeze pressure is building - not actionable yet, but watch for FR going deeper negative.
FUNDING_SIG_SHORTS_CROWDED_ACTION: Look for long entries on dips. Do NOT short here.
FUNDING_SIG_SHORTS_CROWDED_DESC: The market is heavily positioned short. Shorts are paying longs every 8 hours just to hold their position - they are the fuel for the next pump. Whales can push price up to mass-liquidate these shorts and collect their money. This is a squeeze setup, not a short signal.
FUNDING_SIG_SHORTS_OVERCROWDED_ACTION: Strong long setup. Do NOT short. Size up on dips.
FUNDING_SIG_SHORTS_OVERCROWDED_DESC: Extreme short crowding - traders are paying 0.03%+ every 8h just to stay short. This is unsustainable. Historically, this level of negative funding precedes a violent squeeze pump as whales push price up to liquidate the overleveraged shorts.

SPOTLIGHT_TOUR_OI_CAPTION: Each red bar = more shorts entering. The last 3 bars (red) accelerated - a squeeze is loading.
SPOTLIGHT_TOUR_STEP1_BODY: When shorts overcrowd a market and price reverses, they all close at once - that spike is the squeeze. LiquidityHQ detects it before it fires.
SPOTLIGHT_TOUR_STEP2_BODY: When funding is negative, shorts pay longs to hold their position. It means the market is overcrowded on the short side - and that's exactly the fuel a squeeze needs.
SPOTLIGHT_TOUR_STEP3_BODY: More shorts are opening. Every new short is potential energy. When price reverses even slightly, margin calls cascade - that acceleration is the squeeze.
SPOTLIGHT_TOUR_STEP4_TITLE: LiquidityHQ scores it and alerts you.
SPOTLIGHT_TOUR_STEP4_BODY: Funding rate, OI change, volume, and RSI are combined into a single score. When it hits 70+, a Telegram alert fires before the crowd sees the move.

FAQ_INTRO: Answers to the questions we hear most - accounts, signals, alerts, and how LiquidityHQ works.
FAQ_Q_FREE_VS_PRO_Q: What's the difference between Free and Pro?
FAQ_Q_FREE_VS_PRO_A: Free covers the Dashboard, Briefing, News, Scanners, and full charting, plus a limited amount of AI analysis each day. Pro adds the faster timeframes, the Confluence Score, on-chain and macro data, Telegram alerts, unlimited price alerts, and a much larger AI allowance.
FAQ_Q_FREE_TRIAL_A: Yes. Every new account gets 14 days of full Pro access automatically, no card required. You're moved to the Free plan when the trial ends unless you upgrade.
FAQ_Q_CANCEL_PLAN_Q: How do I cancel or change my plan?
FAQ_Q_CANCEL_PLAN_A: Your subscription is billed through our payment processor. You can cancel anytime and you'll keep Pro access until the end of the period you already paid for - no partial refunds, no other action needed.
FAQ_Q_BUYSELL_SIGNAL_Q: What does a BUY or SELL signal mean?
FAQ_Q_BUYSELL_SIGNAL_A: It's the EMA ribbon strategy: a 9/20 EMA cross arms a direction, then the first candle that closes past the 50 EMA confirms it and prints the marker, with an entry, stop, and target shown. The same rule runs on the chart and in every alert, so they're always describing the same signal.
FAQ_Q_CONFLUENCE_SCORE_A: A Pro feature that combines the EMA ribbon, order flow, multi-timeframe RSI, choppiness, and RSI divergence into a single directional score, so you don't have to weigh five indicators yourself.
FAQ_Q_FINANCIAL_ADVICE_A: No. Everything on LiquidityHQ - signals, scores, alerts, and AI commentary - is for informational purposes only. Nothing here is a recommendation to buy, sell, or hold any asset, and we're not a registered investment advisor.
FAQ_Q_AI_DISAGREE_Q: Why might the AI say something different from the chart?
FAQ_Q_AI_DISAGREE_A: LiquidityAI is powered by xAI Grok, and like any AI it can be incomplete or wrong. Treat it as a second opinion, not the final word - always check it against the raw data on the chart.
FAQ_Q_TELEGRAM_SETUP_Q: How do I get Telegram alerts?
FAQ_Q_ALERT_MISMATCH_Q: Why didn't an alert match what's on the chart?
FAQ_Q_ALERT_MISMATCH_A: Alerts use the exact same signal engine as the Arena chart, so a fired alert is always the same confirmed marker the chart is showing. If it looks out of place, check the timeframe the alert was for - it may be describing an earlier candle than the one currently in view.
FAQ_Q_MUTE_ALERTS_A: Yes. On the Alerts page you can mute by coin, by direction, or by rule, so you only get pinged for what you actually care about.
FAQ_Q_ALERT_TF_CAP_Q: How many timeframes can I get alerts for?
FAQ_Q_ALERT_TF_CAP_A: Up to 3 at a time, picked from every timeframe the Arena chart itself offers. Switch them anytime from the Alerts page.
FAQ_Q_WHAT_IS_LHQ_A: Market intelligence for active crypto traders - one dashboard for price action, order flow, sentiment, and AI-assisted signals, instead of juggling a dozen tabs.
FAQ_Q_DATA_SOURCES_Q: Where does your data come from?
FAQ_Q_DATA_SOURCES_A: Price, funding, and open interest data comes from Binance, Bybit, Finnhub, and Alternative.me. We do not guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or availability of any third-party feed.
FAQ_Q_CUSTODY_Q: Do you have custody of my funds?
FAQ_Q_CUSTODY_A: No. LiquidityHQ is a read-only analytics and alerting tool - there's no wallet connection and we never touch or trade your funds.
FAQ_Q_WHO_FOR_A: Active and retail crypto traders who want one place to read the market and get notified when it moves, instead of stitching together TradingView, exchange apps, and a Telegram bot themselves.
FAQ_Q_TELEGRAM_SETUP_A: Telegram alerts are a Pro feature. Open the Alerts page and press Connect Telegram. You get a one-time code and two steps: open the bot, then send it the /start message shown on the page - there is a Copy button so you do not have to type it. The page updates itself the moment the bot receives it, and you never have to find or copy a chat ID.

FUNDING_TIP_MILD_POS: The fee longs pay shorts every 8 hours to keep perpetual futures positions open. Mildly positive means longs are paying shorts - a slight bullish lean, not an extreme.
FUNDING_TIP_NEUTRAL: The fee longs pay shorts every 8 hours to keep perpetual futures positions open. Near zero means no crowded side, so a liquidation raid is less likely either way.
FUNDING_TIP_MILD_NEG: The fee longs pay shorts every 8 hours to keep perpetual futures positions open. Mildly negative means shorts are paying longs - a slight bearish lean, not an extreme.
